name: The Oita Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Oita Bank, Ltd. provides various banking products and services to individual and corporate clients primarily in Japan. The company offers general saving, fixed deposit, and foreign currency deposit accounts; mortgage; housing, business, free, card, car, education, renovation, and vacant house demolition and utilization loans; reverse mortgage; and insurance services. It also provides safe deposit box; internet banking; payment; foreign currency; mail order; web account transfer reception and fund transfer acceptance; automatic pension payment; forex web; debit and credit card; and foreign remittance services.
